title: Ali Masjid Gaya! 🕌 | Masjid Mein Dakhil Hone Ki Dua | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Ali pehli baar Abbu ke saath masjid gaya! 🕌 Masjid ke darwaze par joote utaarna, daayan pair pehle andar rakhna aur masjid mein dakhil hone ki dua — bachchon ke liye ek pyaari Islamic kahani.

Dua: "Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik"
Matlab: Aye Allah, mere liye apni rehmat ke darwaze khol de.
English: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

📖 Source:
• Masjid mein dakhil hone ki dua — Sahih Muslim 713, Abu Humaid / Abu Usaid (RA) (Sahih)
• Achhe kaam daayein se shuru karna — Sahih Bukhari 168, Sahih Muslim 268, Aisha (RA) (Sahih)

Aap ka bachcha yeh dua yaad kar le to comment mein "Ameen" likhein! 🤲
Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah: Ali aur Dadu.
